title: 第12章 中州唐安，请指教第13章 王锋的实力
content_zh:
第012章 第一场，胜
抽完签，唐安看了一眼自己刚抽到的号码，是“甲字28号”。
唐安便独自走到了甲字号的擂台附近去等候。
场内总共有284人要参加比斗，但是擂台却只有8个，只能满足256人分组参加比斗，所以多出来的18人，必须抽签先于别人比斗一场，淘汰18人才能继续。
今天比斗，赢的条件非常简单，要么就是把对方打出擂台，要么就是让对方失去反抗能力，要么对方投降。只要满足三者其中之一，就算胜利。
比斗之时，不能使用武器，只能徒手比，每个擂台周围都有2名内门弟子作为裁判
唐安独自站在甲字号擂台之下，忽然，他看到一个人，嘴角慢慢掀起了一丝冷笑。
王锋叼着嘴巴一脸得意的朝唐安走来！
唐安不屑的看了他一眼，在他眼里，这不过是靠父亲蒙荫的纨绔子弟。不过，那一天的屈辱，唐安却绝不会忘记。等下擂台，若是遇到这王锋，唐安一定不会手软！
那王锋走到唐安面前几步之处，却是不再接近。
他看了一眼边上的内门弟子，嘴角却是慢慢扯开，手上比划了一下那天唐安是如何倒飞出去做了狗吃屎的模样。
他看到唐安的脸色，顿时青了一下，心中更加得意。当场就哈哈大笑起来。
“我听说你要找我报仇，所以三个月来不停地在后面溪流处苦练？不过就算你再多苦练三个月，废物还是废物！”
说完，他不屑的朝地上吐了一口口水，一甩衣袍，便朝擂台的另一边大摇大摆的走了过去。
唐安握了握拳头，他本来不想同这个纨绔子弟计较的，可不曾想对方如此不识好歹。
“等下若是遇到你，我一定要你好看！”
而就在这时，唐安脑中系统又发布任务了。
【叮~系统任务：蜀山内门弟子考核任务。宿主每赢得一场比斗，获得声望1点，最终获得内门弟子资格，奖励神秘礼物。PS：目前宿主拥有声望为1，请多多努力。】
唐安听完系统的任务，为了那传说中的神秘任务，他这次也要拼命了！
他转身走到擂台的一边等着看别人如何比斗。

小屁孩们按照号码，一个个轮流上台。
32号，31号，30号……
“28号，唐安，上擂台！”
终于等到了！
听到裁判的喊话，唐安利索的将外套一扔，光着膀子上了擂台。
看着面前这个比自己小了一圈的小屁孩，唐安心里不会有任何的大意。无论对方的外表看起来多么普通，甚至那神情里对于自己还有一些害怕。可是他毕竟也是一个能举起300斤石锁的孩童。假以时日，也会是一方豪杰！
唐安对着面前的小屁孩一拱手，行了一个比武礼，大声道：“中州唐安，请指教！”
对面那小屁孩被唐安一喊，随即脸色激动的涨红起来，心底也跟着热血沸腾起来。
这是我人生中的第一场比武啊！就算对面那人看起来比我凶猛，但是爹常教导我，男子汉大丈夫，绝不能未战先怯，就算注定要输，也要迎难而上，不然将来如何闯荡江湖！况且，我也未必会输！
想到这里，那个小屁孩大步往前一跨，也学着唐安的模样利索的一拱手：“清河杨朗，请指教！”
“开始！”旁边裁判一挥手，两人便迅速的分开。
唐安紧紧地盯着对方的眼睛，原本清澈的眸子，此刻却散发着凶悍，就像一匹狼一样，盯得对方心底发寒。
很快，唐安就从他的眼神里捕捉到了自己想要的东西。
就在这时，唐安动了！就在他看到对方的眼神里闪过了一丝犹豫的时候，唐安动了！
他的大腿猛地一蹬，擂台周围的人只听到“踏”的一声脆响，就看到唐安如同猎豹捕食一样扑了出去，紧随着，他的拳头便刺破空气，戾啸着冲向对手。
唐安的出手太快，快的让对手还在错愕之间便被他近身，但是在那一瞬间，对手却硬生生的避开了那一击重拳的位置，虽然被擦了一下，但是他确实避开了。
唐安心中一凛。不过，唐安最不惧怕的就是近身，虽然对手躲开了一下，可是唐安也不慌乱，立马左拳紧握，砸向对手的左边脖颈，可是出乎唐安的意料，那人似乎并没有刻意去闪避，头竟然向前再欠了一下，左臂像水蛇一样颤了过去。
有诡异！
底下人看到这个情景，忽然有人惊呼了起来：“是蛇拳！”
蛇拳最为诡异，对于肌肉的柔度韧性爆发力的要求非常之高！不过唐安浑然不惧。

“以为凭蛇拳的出其不意便能胜我？天真！”
唐安看到那一拳朝自己而来，当即以前脚为轴，后脚跟着一转，便躲开那一拳，闪到了那人侧面，弯下腰，一拳爆出！
“这一拳，我看你怎么躲！”
那人一惊，不过身子反应却不满，赶忙扭转身躯，又是险险的避开了。
看到对手躲开，唐安不禁没有气馁，反而嘴角慢慢咧开。
就在这时，他的拳头忽然散开！
突然出现的手指，恰好抵住了那人的腰间，他仅用指尖的力道猛的弹了一下对手的腰间。
那人顿时便感到一阵剧痛从腰间传来！想要凝气，却是怎么也不行了！
他弯着腰，额头全是冷汗，纯粹是疼的。
底下的小屁孩没有看清楚，两边的内门弟子可是看得清清楚楚。“还算懂得进退，知道手下留情。要是伤了对方，我们在师傅那里可不好交代。”
两方一触碰就闪开，只来回斗了两个回合，根本没有看清楚发生了什么。不过场中唐安昂首而立，对手却是弯腰喊痛，冷汗不断。胜负已分！
“28号唐安，胜！”
唐安深吸了一口气，慢慢将心头的兴奋感平复下来。第一次与人对战，那交战的画面就像事先在自己脑中刻画好一样，一切似乎都在按照自己的想法进行。
“这种一切尽在掌握中的感觉实在是太好了！”
其实唐安已经进入【天人第二重，洗髓伐经】了，只是他之前一直不敢相信。
300斤的力气，已经是天人第一重的极限了，他的力气已经到了400斤，不是天人第二重，那也说不过去了。
境界不同，差距便是十分明显，无论是力量速度，还是对身体的把握。这场比斗，他赢也是理所当然！
content_en:
Chapter 012 The first game, victory
After drawing the lots, Tang An took a look at the number he had just drawn. It was "No. 28".
Tang An walked alone to the ring near the number A and waited.
There are a total of 284 people in the venue who want to participate in the competition, but there are only 8 arenas, which can only accommodate 256 people in groups to participate in the competition. Therefore, the extra 18 people must draw lots to compete before others, and 18 people can be eliminated before continuing.
In today's competition, the conditions for winning are very simple. Either knock the opponent out of the ring, make the opponent lose the ability to resist, or surrender. As long as one of the three is met, it is considered a victory.
During the competition, you cannot use weapons and can only compete with your bare hands. There are two inner disciples around each ring as referees.
Tang An stood alone under the number A ring. Suddenly, he saw a person, and a sneer slowly appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Wang Feng walked towards Tang An with his mouth in his mouth and a proud look on his face!
Tang An gave him a disdainful look. In his eyes, this was just a playboy who relied on his father's influence. However, Tang An will never forget the humiliation of that day. After getting off the stage, if he meets Wang Feng, Tang An will not show any mercy!
Wang Feng walked a few steps in front of Tang An, but was no longer close.
He glanced at the inner disciple beside him, but slowly opened the corner of his mouth, and made a gesture with his hand on how Tang An flew out like a dog eating shit that day.
When he saw Tang An's face, he suddenly turned green and felt even more proud. He burst out laughing on the spot.
"I heard that you wanted to take revenge on me, so you have been practicing hard at the stream behind you for three months? But even if you practice hard for another three months, you will still be a waste!"
After saying that, he spat on the ground disdainfully, flicked his robe, and walked swaggering towards the other side of the ring.
Tang An clenched his fists. He originally didn't want to argue with this dandy, but he never expected him to be so ignorant.
"If I meet you later, I will make sure you look good!"
At this moment, the system in Tang An's mind issued another mission.
[Ding~ System task: Shushan inner disciple assessment task. Each time the host wins a battle, he will gain 1 reputation point, and will eventually be qualified as an inner disciple and be rewarded with a mysterious gift. PS: The host currently has a reputation of 1, please work hard. 】
After Tang An listened to the system's mission, he was going to work hard this time for the legendary mysterious mission!
He turned around and walked to the side of the ring to wait to see how others would compete.
The little kids took turns on stage one by one according to their numbers.
No. 32, No. 31, No. 30...
"No. 28, Tang An, come to the ring!"
The wait is finally here!
Upon hearing the referee's call, Tang An neatly threw his coat away and entered the ring shirtless.
Looking at the kid in front of him who was a little smaller than himself, Tang An didn't feel careless. No matter how ordinary the other person looks, there is even some fear of him in his expression. But after all, he is also a child who can lift a 300-pound stone lock. In time, he will become a hero!
Tang An raised his hands to the little kid in front of him, performed a martial arts salute, and said loudly: "Zhongzhou Tang An, please give me some advice!"
When Tang An called out to the little kid opposite, his face turned red with excitement, and his heart began to boil with excitement.
This is the first martial arts competition in my life! Even if the person opposite me looks fiercer than me, my father always taught me that a man should never be timid before fighting. Even if he is doomed to lose, he must face the difficulties, otherwise he will not be able to succeed in the world in the future! Besides, I may not lose!
Thinking of this, the little kid strode forward and imitated Tang An's example and raised his hands neatly: "Qinghe Yang Lang, please give me some advice!"
"Start!" The referee waved his hand, and the two quickly separated.
Tang An stared closely into the other person's eyes, his originally clear eyes,At this moment, he was exuding ferocity, like a wolf, staring at the opponent with chills in his heart.
Soon, Tang An caught what he wanted from his eyes.
At this moment, Tang An moved! Just when he saw a trace of hesitation flashing in the other person's eyes, Tang An moved!
His thigh kicked hard, and the people around the ring only heard a crisp sound of "step", and saw Tang An leaping out like a cheetah preying on prey. Immediately afterwards, his fist pierced the air and rushed towards the opponent with a roar.
Tang An's shot was too fast, so fast that his opponent was close to him while he was still stunned. However, at that moment, his opponent abruptly avoided the position of the heavy punch. Although it was brushed, he did avoid it.
Tang An was shocked. However, what Tang An was least afraid of was the close quarters. Although his opponent dodged for a moment, Tang An did not panic. He immediately clenched his left fist and hit the left side of his opponent's neck. However, to Tang An's expectation, the man did not seem to deliberately dodge. His head actually bowed forward, and his left arm trembled like a water snake.
Something weird!
When the people below saw this scene, someone suddenly exclaimed: "It's Snake Fist!"
Snake Fist is the weirdest, requiring very high flexibility, flexibility and explosive power of the muscles! But Tang An was not afraid at all.
"Think you can defeat me just by taking the Snake Fist by surprise? You are naive!"
When Tang An saw the punch coming towards him, he immediately pivoted with his front foot and turned with his back foot. He dodged the punch, dodged to the side of the man, bent down, and punched out!
"I'll see how you dodge this punch!"
The man was startled, but his body reaction was dissatisfied. He quickly turned around and narrowly avoided it again.
Seeing his opponent dodge, Tang An couldn't help but not be discouraged, but instead slowly grinned.
At this moment, his fist suddenly spread out!
The fingers that suddenly appeared hit the man's waist, and he flicked his opponent's waist with just the strength of his fingertips.
The man suddenly felt a sharp pain coming from his waist! I want to condense my energy, but I can’t do it!
He was bent over and his forehead was covered in cold sweat, it was just out of pain.
The kid below didn't see it clearly, but the inner disciples on both sides could see it clearly. "You still know how to advance and retreat, and you know how to be merciful. If we hurt the other party, it will be difficult for us to explain it to the master."
The two parties moved away as soon as they came into contact, and they only fought back and forth for two rounds without seeing clearly what was going on. However, in the middle of the court, Tang An stood with his head held high, while his opponent bent over and cried out in pain, sweating continuously. The outcome is decided!
"No. 28 Tang An, wins!"
Tang An took a deep breath and slowly calmed down the excitement in his heart. The first time I fought against someone, it was as if the scene of the battle had been carved in my mind beforehand, and everything seemed to be going according to my own ideas.
“It feels so good to have everything under control!”
In fact, Tang An has already entered the [Second Level of Heaven and Humanity, Cleansing the Marrow and Cutting the Sutras], but he couldn't believe it before.
The strength of 300 kilograms is already the limit of the first weight of heavenly beings. His strength has reached 400 kilograms, which is not the second weight of heavenly beings. That doesn't make sense.
Different realms, the gap is very obvious, whether it is strength, speed, or control of the body. It's natural for him to win this fight!
